'''Aleix Viladot Caramés''' (born 26 June 1997) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]] for [[Penya Encarnada d'Andorra|Penya Encarnada]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{Soccerway|aleix-carames/271054|Aleix Viladot}}</ref>

==Career==

Viladot started his career with Andorran side [[FC Andorra]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/viladot-tambe-es-lesiona-i-estara-quinze-dies-de-baixa|title=Viladot també es lesiona i
